verdict.rationale: Vanta documents obtaining an access token for the Manage Vanta API, and an official MCP server through which AI assistants call the API 'on your behalf' and 'securely'. So agent-usable credentials exist. However, nothing in the evidence shows that those credentials can be scoped or limited to least privilege. Missing for 10: documented credential scopes or permission granularity, per-agent or per-app credential issuance, read-only versus write limits, and independent corroboration.
